teaser.en: Its Digo name calls it the guardian of the water pond, and that is exactly where you find it standing.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linauita mlinzi wa bwawa la maji, na hapo ndipo hasa utakapoukuta ukiwa umesimama.

summary.en: Mrinda ziya is a soft-wooded, aromatic shrub of pond edges and wet hollows. Its Digo name, 'water pond protector', describes where it grows.
summary.sw: Mrinda ziya ni kichaka chenye mbao laini na harufu nzuri, kinachoota kandokando ya mabwawa na kwenye mabonde yenye unyevu. Jina lake la Kidigo, 'mlinzi wa bwawa la maji', linaeleza mahali kinapoota.

about.en: Mrinda ziya is a bushy shrub, usually head-high or a little more, with soft, slightly hairy grey-green leaves that smell strongly when crushed. At the ends of the branches it carries small, crowded flower heads in pink to mauve, typical of the daisy family but without obvious petals. Pakia notes that the Digo recognise it by the look of the whole plant rather than by any single part.
about.sw: Mrinda ziya ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida kimo cha mtu au zaidi kidogo, chenye majani laini ya kijivu-kijani yenye vinyweleo kidogo, yanayotoa harufu kali yakipondwa. Kwenye ncha za matawi huzaa vichwa vidogo vya maua vilivyosongamana, vya rangi ya waridi hadi zambarau hafifu, kama ilivyo kawaida katika familia ya Asteraceae (jamii ya daisy), ila bila petali zinazoonekana wazi. Pakia anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima badala ya sehemu moja moja.

where.en: It grows wherever water collects: around seasonal ponds (ziya), in wet hollows and along ditches and stream margins. It tolerates wet and somewhat salty ground, so it is often one of the few shrubs standing in a pond basin after the water has dried back.
where.sw: Huota popote maji yanapokusanyika: kuzunguka mabwawa ya msimu (ziya), kwenye mabonde yenye unyevu, kando ya mitaro na kingo za vijito. Huvumilia ardhi yenye maji na yenye chumvi kiasi, hivyo mara nyingi ni mojawapo ya vichaka vichache vinavyobaki vimesimama ndani ya bwawa baada ya maji kukauka.

culture.en: The name is a small description of the landscape. Pakia uses it as an example of how Digo plant names mark habitat: species of freshwater ponds carry the affix ziya, as in Mrinda ziya and Ndago ziya, the nutgrass of wet places.
culture.sw: Jina hili ni maelezo mafupi ya mandhari. Pakia analitumia kama mfano wa jinsi majina ya mimea ya Kidigo yanavyoonyesha makazi: spishi za mabwawa ya maji baridi hubeba kiambishi ziya, kama katika Mrinda ziya na Ndago ziya, ndago wa mahali penye maji.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mrinda ziya and explains it as 'water pond protector', because the shrub is so commonly found near ponds. No other Mijikenda or Swahili name is recorded for it. In English it is called marsh fleabane; its scientific name is Pluchea dioscoridis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mrinda ziya na kulifafanua kuwa 'mlinzi wa bwawa la maji', kwa sababu kichaka hiki hupatikana mara nyingi karibu na mabwawa. Hakuna jina jingine la Kimijikenda wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *marsh fleabane*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Pluchea dioscoridis.

reason.en: Another Pluchea shrub, named for fishing
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha jenasi Pluchea, kilichopewa jina kutokana na uvuvi
Nao pia hubeba kiambishi cha 'bwawa', ziya

reason.en: Named for its liking for water
reason.sw: Umepewa jina kwa sababu ya kupenda maji
